module: Setup and teardown of a freeform delivery. Associates the vehicles already spawned by the loader (delivery._vehicleIndex, by internalName) with the delivery's IDs, applies their starting state (gearbox mode, gear, engine, ignition level), registers previews, schedules couplings (couplings) via util_stepHandler, places the player (in a vehicle, on foot or on a parking spot) and stores the initial positions for a reset.
notes: Vehicles are not spawned here: setup() finds them via delivery._vehicleIndex[internalName]; a missing entry is logged as an error and ignored.
startupCode accepts driveMode (setGearboxMode), gear (setGear on the transmission device), engineOn (startEngine/stopEngine); setIgnitionLevel goes through core_vehicleBridge.executeAction.
playerStart.type: "vehicle" (vehicleId), "walking" (position {x,y,z}, optional rotation {x,y,z,w}) or "parkingSpot" (targetAreaId of a parkingSpot-type zone).

Couplings: wait for vehicles to be ready (8 s max), activation via beamstate.activateAutoCoupling(nodeTag), then verification in core_trailerRespawn (8 s max). The timeouts are safeguards: on timeout the sequence continues without blocking.
Check isSetupComplete() before starting: it stays false as long as a vehicle is not ready or a coupling is pending.
A vehicle with enterable == false is added to the gameplay_walk blacklist.

setup.desc: Prepares the delivery: resolves the target area images, indexes the spawned vehicles, applies the starting state, blacklists non-enterable vehicles, collects and launches the couplings, places the player and stores the initial transforms.

returns.desc: false if delivery is nil, otherwise true (asynchronous operations continue afterwards).

isSetupComplete.desc: Returns whether the asynchronous setup is finished (all vehicles ready and no coupling pending). When so, sets setupInProgress back to false.

returns.desc: true if finished or not started.

restoreVehicleTransforms.desc: Puts each vehicle back at its initial position/rotation (physics reset, flexmesh repaired), reapplies the starting state then restarts the coupling sequence.

getVehicleId.desc: Converts a delivery vehicle ID into a game object ID.

deliveryVehicleId.desc: Vehicle ID in the delivery definition.

returns.desc: true as long as setup/reset is not finished.

setupPlayer.desc: Places the player according to delivery.playerStart (vehicle, walking at a position, or walking on a parking spot).

getPendingCouplings.desc: List of vehicle IDs with a pending coupling.

getAllCouplingSetup.desc: Returns the list of couplings collected during the last setup.

getSpawnedVehicles.desc: Returns the vehicles keyed by object ID.

freezeAllVehicles.desc: Freezes or unfreezes all vehicles of the delivery (setFreeze action via core_vehicleBridge).

freeze.desc: true by default; false to unfreeze.

cleanup.desc: Tears down the delivery: if keepVehicles, extracts the vehicles from the prefabs (exploding the prefab) and puts them back in MissionGroup; removes the created prefabs (and reloads collision if needed); otherwise removes the vehicles. Then clears all state.

keepVehicles.desc: true to keep the vehicles (false by default).
